business_summary: An inclusive apparel brand offering shapewear, loungewear, and underwear in sizes XXS-5X, targeting women aged 22-40 who purchase on drops and are not discount-driven.

relevant_tags.why: Core product category is apparel (loungewear, underwear, shapewear).
Underwear is explicitly mentioned as a core product.
Shapewear and underwear fall directly under the intimates category.
Primary demographic target is explicitly stated as mostly women 22-40.
Brand highlights inclusive sizing from XXS up to 5X.
Underwear and simple loungewear are highly adjacent to daily basics.
Loungewear is a core component of casual apparel.

persona_conflicts.evidence: Don't send us people who only shop discount.

note_signals.why: Activewear and fitness-engaged women have a strong crossover with loungewear and intimates.
